# Dreams in Paris

> > Dreams in Paris provides curated Paris travel itineraries and local recommendations to help visitors experience the city like a local.

This site offers detailed trip planning resources for Paris, including walking routes, restaurant suggestions, and digital travel guides designed to maximize your time in the French capital.

## Key Topics

- Paris travel planning
- 3-day itineraries
- Walking routes and maps
- Local restaurant recommendations
- Digital travel guides
- Tourist attractions and sights
- Google Maps integration
- Trip planning tools
- Paris neighborhoods
- French capital tourism

## Paris Itineraries & Travel Guides

- [3-Day Paris Itinerary](https://dreamsinparis.com/3-days-in-paris-itinerary): 3-day Paris itinerary with walking routes, top sights & local restaurants
